Offline axis-label recognition uses Tesseract.js (naptha/tesseract.js), its
WebAssembly core (naptha/tesseract.js-core), and the English LSTM recognition
data from Tesseract (tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast). Each is distributed under
Apache License 2.0. The bundled JavaScript license notices accompany the code.
The uncompressed English model SHA-256 is
7d4322bd2a7749724879683fc3912cb542f19906c83bcc1a52132556427170b2.
